reviewed_controls.authority: ACTIVE_DIRECT_USER_CONTINUATION and automatic_resume:false, pinned committed run_control and current canonical HEAD
reviewed_controls.stable_workflow_byte_lock: Original exact file identity retained; byte0 actual OS lock held until new owned execution ends
reviewed_controls.preferred: Same196 AA, -p, MFP, B1000, SH-aLRT1000, seed1961008, T2, keep-ident, boot-trees; no unsupported partition --mem
reviewed_controls.actual_limits: Queried 0x2310 owned-job affinity/process+aggregate committed caps; suspended native assigned and membership/affinity checked before exactly one resume
reviewed_controls.process_identity: Creation FILETIME, executable, native exit and CPU via retained OS handle; SessionID retained from live child for post-exit receipts
reviewed_controls.bounded_execution: At most30min resource admission and24h native runtime; owned-job-only timeout cleanup; no duplicate relaunch
reviewed_controls.closure: Exact child signaled with nonzero exit FILETIME and matching retained creation PLUS queried empty new owned job required; unproven new closure fatal
reviewed_controls.nonzero_exit: FAILED_RETRYABLE only after new child/job closure; exit0 means VALIDATION_REQUIRED
reviewed_controls.historical_closure: No old process lifetime or exit inferred or required for this separate fresh-exclusive job
reviewed_controls.power: Temporary controller-thread idle-sleep prevention; explicit release receipt; no power/logoff survival claim

repaired_findings: Manual continuation authority matches current published run_control semantics
